output_list.criticism: The mintToken function is the only way to mint tokens, which is beneficial for the owner. However, the function does not restrict the amount of tokens that can be minted. This could lead to the token devaluing, as more tokens are minted than are actually needed to compensate the owner for the gas cost of the transaction. The function should be modified to mint only enough tokens to compensate the owner for the gas cost of the transaction, and no more.
